Name: Monsoon's Umbrellas Starter Pack (For Umbrellas)
Author: monsoonsheep
Description:
This mod contains a few of the umbrella models I've made for my Umbrella mod. It uses Content Patcher to add the data and textures.

NPCs I've made umbrellas for so far:

[list]
[*]Penny
[*]Leah
[*]Abigail
[*]Evelyn (even though she never goes outside in the rain 😅)
[*]Sebastian (the umbrella is just the one he uses in his 8-heart event)
[/list]
